```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(UpSetR)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
df <- read.csv("T:/Labs/Spakowicz/ppiio/data/derived/2025-02-17/CoRR_formatted.csv") %>%
  select( ppi, statin, h2b_iostart, steroid_iostart, abx_iostart, nsaid_iostart)
df <- df %>%
  rename(
    `PPI` = ppi,
    `Statin` = statin, 
    `H2B` = h2b_iostart,
    `Steroids` = steroid_iostart,
    `ABx` = abx_iostart,
    `NSAIDs` = nsaid_iostart)
```

```{r}
svg("../figures/cm_upset.svg", width = 6, height = 3.5)
upset(df,
      sets = c("NSAIDs", "ABx", "Steroids", "H2B", "Statin", "PPI"), 
     order.by = "freq",             
      main.bar.color = "slateblue2",
      sets.bar.color = NA,
     sets.x.label ="",
     set_size.show = FALSE,
     text.scale = c(1.5, 1, 2.0, 0, 1.25, 1.25))
dev.off()


```
